messages:
Maria: FYI customer sent back the security questionnaire. Two sticky items: per-customer immutable audit trail + BYOK key import/export controls. Can we do a quick triage?
Ajay: quick read — audit trail ask is basically: separate tenant-level audit index, 365d retention, immutable writes, and tamper-evidence. BYOK asks require import flow, key escrow controls, and HSM-backed wrapping.
Tony: For audit we already stream events to ES and S3. Problem is the current ES index is shared across tenants.
Carol: +1. We had discussed per-tenant indices before for compliance customers. Impacts on billing/ops though.
Maria: Customer wants proof of deletion too — they want ability to show X days after termination we deleted keys and data and provide log evidence.
Ajay: For keys: we support KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) with CMKs, and we have a BYOK MVP that allows import via encrypted key blobs. But we lack a documented customer-facing flow and attestation artifacts.
Samir: Vulnerability triage note: the questionnaire called out CVE-2023-xxxxx in a third-party lib we pulled in. That was patched last month — we should include fix version in the response.
Maria: Action item: compile evidence items (logs, key op audit, patch notes) and draft a secure Q&A. Who takes what?
Tony: I can prototype per-tenant audit indices: config flag, roll-over policy, ILM -> 365d, TTL. Will need runbook for restore.
Ajay: I'll doc the BYOK import flow and required HSM wrapping steps. Need product decision on whether we allow customer-managed HSM or only cloud KMS.
Carol: I'll collect deletion proof: S3 deletion lifecycle + object versioning + deletion markers. Also capture KMS key schedule and deletion logs.
SecurityBot: Reminder: open a ticket in SEC-REQS for this customer, link evidence artifacts to the ticket.
Maria: Samir can you confirm the vuln patch versions and provide a short blurb for the questionnaire vulnerability section?
Samir: Yep — patched to libfoo v2.4.1 on 2028-01-12, mitigated exposure window was 6 hours. I'll paste the commit and CVE mapping.
Maria: Quick Q re: audit immutability — can we use S3 Object Lock + write-once bucket for the canonical audit stash and keep ES for analytics?
Ajay: That seems sensible. S3 Object Lock for WORM + separate signing of each log batch (HMAC) to prove tamper-evidence. We'll need to rotate HMAC keys and store rotation history in the audit metadata.
Tony: Ops note: per-tenant ES indices increase shard count; we should shard by customer ID prefix and apply index lifecycle policies. Will measure headroom first.
Carol: Data deletion: for BYOK tenants, key destruction policy can be customer-triggered with a retention hold window. Document how we produce a signed deletion receipt (timestamp, key-id, hash of deleted objects).
Maria: Customers also asked about KMS access controls: who has ability to create/rotate keys on our side? They want separation of duties.
Ajay: We have RBAC roles in Console: infra-admin, sec-admin, tenant-admin. Need to add explicit 'kms-operator' role that cannot access data plane. Proposal: kms-operator manages keys but not read data; tenant-admin can bind customer keys to tenant but not rotate.
Tony: Also need audit hooks for role escalations and ephemeral token issuance. We'll log STS token issuance and store in audit S3.
Maria: Good. Draft response should include: architecture diagram (audit flow), BYOK import steps, HSM/WRAP options, RBAC table, vuln patch note, and deletion attestation template.
Samir: I'll attach the CVE blurb + PR link in the ticket.
Maria: Timebox: let's have an internal review doc by EOD tomorrow so we can hit the customer's deadline.
Ajay: I'll open SEC-REQS-789 and assign sub-tasks.
SecurityBot: SEC-REQS-789 created by Ajay. Link: https://redwood.internal/SEC-REQS-789
Carol: Adding checklist: evidence export steps, retention policy text, sample signed deletion receipt, S3 Object Lock config, and per-tenant index ILM.
Tony: If we hit scale issues we'll propose a hybrid: S3 WORM for canonical + daily ES index snapshots for fast queries.
Maria: Thanks all — please drop short notes in the ticket so I can assemble the final Q&A. :thumbsup:
